name: Maintenance Mode Redirect
description: Redirects visitors to a configured URL while the site is in maintenance mode.
project_description:
Warning message 
 Do not use the development versions in production sites. They are thought to be used to help with the development of the module.

 
 This module redirects site visitors to another URL when maintenance mode is enabled. This is useful when it is desired to host a static maintenance page on another hosting provider.

 The module adds two additional fields to the Maintenance Mode configuration page (admin/config/development/maintenance). The checkbox is used to enable URL redirect when the site is in maintenance mode. The Redirect URL field should contain a valid URL to which users who cannot access the site in maintenance mode are redirected.
